answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1738 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the yarrow. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the river queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. The trellis index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 40 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
